response.reason: This lens audits contract completeness, containment/cardinality structure, owner default-entry semantics, transition-group guard collisions, and wrong-target endpoints by contrasting the author-source PlantUML/canonical inventory against the closed FCSTM. Key finding: InMotion (owner) has no exact default entry to any of its three NL-required substates (Accelerating/Cruising/Approaching); the FCSTM instead synthesizes an owner-local initial edge to a compiler-owned UnspecifiedInitial placeholder, so NL5's Accelerating first-entry contract is violated at the owner-scope level. This root cause also explains why all downstream Accelerating/Cruising/Approaching endpoint transitions exist as edges but are unreachable in the closed model; per governing instructions, existing exact endpoints/triggers with correct source/target are not converted into wrong_target/mismatched issues merely because their source composite is unreachable, so NL1-ENDPOINT-1, NL2-ENDPOINT-1/2, NL5-ENDPOINT-1, NL6-ENDPOINT-1, NL7-ENDPOINT-1 and their trigger_set companions are omitted as satisfied endpoint/trigger facts. The InMotion->Stopping and InMotion->EmergencyStopping alternatives (NL2 group) are realized in FCSTM via a synthetic guard on R45RouteToken rather than the named Arrived/Obstacle Detected events; because the guard values (6 vs 7) are set exclusively by the corresponding named-event effects, the two alternatives remain distinguishable, so guard_disjointness is satisfied and omitted. Containment (NL4-CONTAIN-1/2/3) and cardinality (NL4-CARD-1) are structurally satisfied by the closed model's direct child count of 3 (Accelerating, Cruising, Approaching), so no containment/cardinality candidate is emitted, but the cardinality binding row is still returned as required. The state_action contracts (NL3-ACTION-1, NL8-ACTION-1, NL9-ACTION-1) have exact carriers (EmergencyStopSendObstacleDetected, Accelerate, Send) but all are abstract/no-op bodies per source and flagged W_DEAD_NAMED_ACTION by reference inspection, which is action-fact evidence of missing concrete action content at an otherwise exact carrier state -- kept for the behavior_consequence lens as action content, but this structure lens focuses on the missing owner-default-entry defect as the primary structural gap.
